newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pasminco says output resumes at Elura.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pasminco says output resumes at Elura.

text.p: Pasminco Ltd said on Wednesday that production had resumed at normal levels at its Elura zinc mine near Cobar, New South Wales.
Remedial action to address pillar damage which occurred on April 30 has been completed, Pasminco said.
Pasminco halted production at the mine following the damage, which was caused by blasting.
The Elura mine produced 104,404 tonnes of zinc concentrates and 67,842 tonnes of lead concentrates in the nine months to March 31.
